exceptions.resolution: Single4-mark tariff after (iii) covers all three listed transformations.
Part (b)(ii) carries the joint tariff for (b)(i)–(ii).
Raw (a)(ii) and(c)(ii) labels each carry a joint(i)–(ii) tariff.
Raw(b)(ii) carries the joint2-mark interpretation tariff for(b)(i)–(ii).
Raw(a)(ii) is the joint centre/radius tariff.
